caption:
She took the job to pay off a debt. She didn’t know she was replacing someone.

Three weeks of house-sitting on a remote Cornish headland. Generous pay. A few simple rules.

Rule four: don’t answer the landline.

Answer the Landline is out now in Kindle and paperback. Link in bio. 📞

slides.title: Three weeks. A house on the cliffs. And a phone she mustn’t answer.

slides.heading: The job
slides.body: Ava Kendrick needs the money. So when the pay is this generous, she doesn’t ask why.

slides.heading: The house
slides.body:
The dressing gown left out for her fits exactly.

The neighbour waves from her garden and calls her Claire.

slides.title: Then, at two in the morning, it rings.
